platform_scope: Experimental native macOS15 x64/ARM64 only; no product deployment-minimum change or production approval
trusted_platform_assumption: LibSystem fork housekeeping is trusted platform work; no mathematical pre-guard liveness bound is claimed. Our post-fork child performs native syscalls and checked stack-buffer operations only.
failure_policy: Actual spawn failure records error without any helper PID action; original CPU caller exit2/grace100ms stays independent.
